# v1.1.0-dev.114: One-button tab, foreground-free raises

Pre-release off the `dev` branch. Builds on `v1.1.0-dev.113`.

## The title bar tab is the way back, and only that

When a virtual window's title bar is hidden, the little tab at the top
centre now carries a single button: show the title bar. The manage-panel
and collapsed-windows buttons it also carried made it read as a second
title bar; both actions live on the bar itself, one click after it
returns.

## The group no longer depends on the main window's state

Bringing a virtual window forward used to quietly require the main app
window to have the foreground, because the plain raise Windows ignores
for a background process. The raise now uses a method that works from
any process, positions the container directly under its docked windows
as part of the same move, and a refused focus handover (Parsec input,
a Windows denial) falls back to raising instead of doing nothing. You
should not need to click the main window first any more.

## Install

Auto-updates from dev.53 and later. Otherwise unzip and run.
